description: What 8-K material events were filed today (or in the most recent trading session), severity-ranked. Drops noise/procedural filings by default. Use for "what mattered in the market today?" / "any breaking corporate news?". Defaults to high+medium severity only.

severity.description: Comma-separated severities to include. Default "high,medium". Allowed: high, medium, low, noise.

name: sec_8k_today
